details:
This update for glibc-livepatches fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-4046: Fixed assertion failure when converting inputs may be used to remotely crash an application  (bsc#1261209)
- Add support for live-patching the gconv modules sitting in
  glibc-locale-base or glibc-gconv-modules-extra packages.
- Update json files for current glibc variants that support
  livepatching.
